title: Evaluating AI-Generated Images of Cultural Artifacts with Community-Informed Rubrics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image model outputs of cultural artifacts using community-informed rubrics co-designed with residents of Kerala and Tamil Nadu, India. The rubrics measure the cultural appropriateness, functionality, and recognizability of generated images (e.g., Kasavu saree, Mridangam) and are applied via manual human annotation and automated Multimodal LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.

Evaluating text-to-image representations of assistive technologies (guide canes, braille notetakers) by treating them as the material culture of the blind and low vision (BLV) community. The methodology uses rubrics co-created through workshops with BLV individuals in the UK to score model outputs on functional accuracy and avoidance of hegemonic/sighted-centric stereotypes.
